Grilled Beef Kidneys
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 5, 2009 - 11:28pm

Ingredients




2 beef kidneys - (abt 1 1/2 lbs)
1 tablespoon olive oil
Coarse salt
Freshly-ground black pepper

Preparation

1 Place beef kidneys on the heated grill. Brush with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Cook until firm to the touch but slightly pink in the center, about 10 to 15 minutes. 2 Serves 10. 3 Comments: The key to successful, tender grilling is maintaining the coals at a low, even temperature. To help control the heat, routinely sprinkle the coals with saltwater when they become too hot. This cools the flame and helps to flavor the cooking meat. A mason jar with holes poked through the lid makes an easy "sprinkler" for the fire.
